name: HLE Glascoat Ltd
title: HLE Glascoat Ltd - 522215 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 11% (Omeras loss INR15.3 cr); management says ongoing business ~13.5% and GLE India utilisation near 75%, but Q4 EBITDA only grew with a sub-15% margin and the June quarter faces gas-cost and deferral headwinds.

utilisation.quote: we are now closer to about 75% capacity utilization

triggers.label: GLE India utilisation ~75%
triggers.quote: we are now closer to about 75% capacity utilization

triggers.label: Omeras order book ~INR78 cr, doubled in a quarter
triggers.quote: the order book has almost doubled, and we expect this trend to continue

triggers.label: Agrochem and CDMO companies deferring decisions
triggers.quote: some companies are deferring some decisions because of the ongoing geopolitical situation

triggers.label: 16% EBITDA margin target missed in FY26
triggers.quote: the actual stood at 10%, 11% other than the labor law changes and the Omeras acquisitions

triggers.label: Gas cost increases passed on partly
triggers.quote: we have been able to pass on the price increases to a large extent, but so there has been the impact

guidance.value: 14-15% consolidated; 15%+ India; Omeras to double-digit margin in FY27
guidance.quote: Will be in the range of between 14% and 15% on a consol basis.

guidance.value: 15-20% a year for next two years
guidance.quote: we expect the heat transfer business overall to grow at a 15% to 20% range for the next couple of years

guidance.value: well above INR200 crore; EBITDA breakeven at INR200-225 crore
guidance.quote: the aim is to get way above INR200 crores

guidance.metric: Consol revenue INR2,000 cr in ~2 years incl. Omeras
guidance.quote: if we do less than INR2,000 crores, we will be disappointed

prior_guidance_check.quote: the actual stood at 10%, 11% other than the labor law changes and the Omeras acquisitions
we are now closer to about 75% capacity utilization
our current utilization is in the same range, 75% range, plus or minus a few percent

red_flags.label: Revenue flat in India GLE for 4 years
red_flags.quote: the value per equipment has gone down to such an extent that you don't see the growth in the business

red_flags.label: Omeras loss-making; FY26 EBITDA up only 5.4% on 31.7% revenue growth
red_flags.quote: EBITDA loss of INR15.3 crores and PAT loss of INR15.6 crores at the recently acquired business of Omeras

red_flags.label: Customer deferrals since Feb 2026
red_flags.quote: some companies are deferring some decisions because of the ongoing geopolitical situation

evasions.quote: Please repeat sorry, I couldn't get your question
the discussion was more related to the overall margins for the second half of the year
